Agent response: Certainly! Here's a summary of our shipping policy to help you understand how we handle deliveries: General Shipping Information: We are unable to expedite shipments or guarantee delivery dates on parcel packages. While placing your order, please ensure your shipping address is correct as we cannot redirect orders once they are on their way. Items may ship from different warehouses, so items ordered together may not always ship together and could arrive at different times. Service Delivery Types and Estimated Times: Small Parcel (UPS / FedEx / USPS): 5 - 8 Business Days (for Mattresses & Pads, Cribs, Seating, and Dressers). Large Parcel (LTL/Room of Choice): 10 - 20 Business Days (for Oversized items). White Glove Delivery: 1 - 10 Business Days (for Oversized items, available to select areas only). Smart Post / USPS: 7 - 10 Business Days (for smallest packages like wood swatches). Special Delivery Services: Room of Choice: This service is for oversized items and includes a skilled delivery team bringing your items inside and placing them in the room of your choosing (up to two flights of stairs). Unboxing, debris removal, and assembly are not included. The carrier will contact you to schedule an appointment. White Glove Delivery: Available in select areas, this includes a two-person delivery team, one flight of stairs, placement in your room of choice, assembly, unpacking, and debris removal. A representative will call you to coordinate an appointment. Shipping Rates: We now offer free shipping on most items! However, rates are subject to change, so please check the rate before finalizing your order. Select items may also require an additional \"Oversize Fee\" due to extra handling, which will be noted when you add the item to your cart. Tracking & Orders: An automated tracking email will be sent to the email address submitted with your order. Allow 3 - 4 business days to receive tracking information for small parcel deliveries and 7 - 10 business days for large parcel deliveries. Cancelling or Modifying Orders: We process orders quickly, so cancellation may not always be possible. We generally have a 1-hour window from when your order is placed to cancel it. To submit a cancellation request, please email cancellation@babyletto.com. Lost, Stolen, or Damaged Orders: If you have concerns about delivery safety, we recommend purchasing Route package protection at checkout. If you did not purchase Route protection and your order is marked as delivered but never arrived, is stolen, or was damaged, please contact us here to initiate an investigation. Shipments received without this pre-registration will not qualify for a credit or refund. For exchanges, we offer a one-time exchange for the original item. Your new order will ship out after we receive and process your returned item.
